cases.counterfactual_program:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
    (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
      (if (= (length cells) 4)
          (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
            (paint-cells out (positions-in-rect (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) color))
          out))))

intermediate: The input-derived selector bounding-box area, used as an integer eligibility threshold.
step_a: Find the unique nonzero color occurring exactly three times and compute the area of its bounding box.
step_b: On a fresh zero grid, fill the bounding box of each color occurring exactly four times only when that box area is at least the selector threshold.
why_b_depends_on_a: Step B cannot determine which four-cell colors qualify until Step A supplies the threshold; changing or skipping that threshold changes the painted target set.
